content.short: OnThis enables DeFi bridging, swapping, and staking on Mantle by simply sending ETH to human-readable shortcut addresses  no dApp interface needed.
content.description: OnThis is an innovative DeFi UX protocol that reduces complex multi-step transactions to a single ETH transfer to specially crafted human-readable addresses. These shortcut addresses automatically execute predefined DeFi operations  such as bridging to Mantle, swapping to a specific token, or staking in a yield protocol  without requiring any dApp interface interaction. This makes Web3 accessible to anyone who can send a basic transaction, eliminating UI complexity entirely.
content.meta: OnThis enables DeFi bridging, swapping, and staking via simple ETH transfers to readable addresses on Mantle. Discover OnThis on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
